name: Kymi Cho
source:
Kymi is always a person you can go to in times of need – be it cheering up, or life advice. While she means well, she’ll often delve into reminiscing about her plethora of experiences, most of which are stacked highly against yours.

As a travel and tourism student, her desire to explore the world is backed by her will to impress those in her family with little will, or ability, to venture overseas.
